He also executive produced NBC’s Who’s Still Standing?  a game show that featured contestants falling through trap doors after answering trivia questions incorrectly.

She was "Playboy" Cyber Girl of the Month for January 2008.  Meghan first appeared on the NBC reality show "Fear Factor" in 2004.  Together with James Wise, her boyfriend at the time, she competed in the Couples edition, doing 8 episodes of the show altogether.
